title: YEONJUN Takes Over The Troubadour for One Night Only
summary: Billboard and HYBE brought lucky fans together for an intimate night celebrating YEONJUN
contentText:
On Wednesday, August 12, Billboard and HYBE brought  One Night Only with YEONJUN  to the iconic Troubadour in Los Angeles, celebrating the global star as he continues to carve out an exciting lane in his solo career. Coming off the momentum of “Ice Cream,” YEONJUN offered 500 lucky fans and their guests a chance to attend a rare, up-close experience—and the excitement was palpable well before doors opened, with fans lining up early to snag a good spot inside.

Rashida Zagon

As fans settled in, DJs Skylar Lee and Johnny Chay set got the night started, spinning crowd-pleasers that quickly turned the Troubadour into a room full of singalongs and set the tone for what was to come. The evening then kicked into gear with a lively Q&A between YEONJUN and Billboard’s Tetris Kelly before transitioning into an intimate, high-energy six-song set.

Backed by enthusiastic dancers and sharp choreography, YEONJUN commanded the intimate stage with performances of fan favorites including his latest single “Ice Cream,” off of his summer released project,  NO LABELS: Part 2 ,   “ FxxkingStar ,” and a surprise encore of “GGUM.” The close quarters only amplified the energy, giving fans a rare opportunity to experience his performance and growing solo artistry just feet away.

Throughout the night, fans could capture their own Polaroid keepsake, and everyone left on a high with an exclusive ice cream sticker and commemorative postcard—a few tangible reminders of a one-night-only evening.

As YEONJUN himself puts it: “Coolin’ off, coolin’ off, make it fun.” Mission accomplished.
